# SkeletonKey API index

> 149 APIs and data sources for agents, with auth header, base URL, pricing and signup facts checked against each vendor's own pages, plus 428 routes (356 verified) to reach them: direct from the vendor or through one of 12 aggregator gateways. Full data: https://skeletonkey.run/apis.json

Status: verified = pricing and auth read on the vendor site; unverified = not confirmed, no prices shown; sales-only = no public prices; no-public-api = reachable only through an aggregator catalog.

## /apis.json schema

Top level: `name`, `url`, `generated`, `count`, `counts` (per status), `route_counts` {`total`, `verified`, `by_source`}, `note`, `apis` (array of vendors), `aggregators` (array of gateway profiles).

Vendor object: `slug`, `name`, `category`, `status`, `summary`, `checked_date`, `listed_by`, `docs_url`, `page`, `sources`. When status is not no-public-api it also has `base_url`, `auth` {`type`,`header`,`format`} and `signup` {`methods`,`url`,`requires_card`,`requires_phone`,`notes`}. Verified vendors add `billing_model`, `billing_unit`, `free_tier`, `free_tier_note`, `min_topup_usd`, `plans[]` {`name`,`price`,`period_or_unit`,`note`} and `pricing_url`. Every vendor has `routes[]` and `when_to_pick[]`.

Route object (`routes[]`, first element is always the direct vendor route, then one per aggregator listing):

- `kind`: `direct` or `aggregator`.
- `source_slug`, `source_name`: `direct` for the vendor itself, otherwise the aggregator slug (see below) and its name.
- `link` / `source_url`: the exact page the figures were read on. Aggregator routes also carry `aggregator_page`.
- `price`: {`usd`, `unit`, `text` (as listed), `per_call_usd_normalized`, `normalized_basis`}. `per_call_usd_normalized` is `usd` when the unit is per call/run/request (`normalized_basis` `per_call`), `usd` when the unit is per result (`per_result`, so cost per call depends on results returned), `usd/1000` when the unit is per 1,000 of something (`per_1k_unit`), and null for any other unit — monthly plans, per-token and per-second prices are not normalized. Direct prices are the lowest per-call rate derivable from the vendor's own pricing page.
- `signup`: {`methods`, `requires_card`, `requires_phone`, `sales_call`, `kyc_or_captcha`}. `sales_call` is true for direct routes sold only through a sales team.
- `payment_model`: for direct routes the vendor's billing model string; for aggregator routes a list of normalized tokens — `prepaid_credits`, `payg`, `subscription`, `x402`, `no_account`.
- `payment_methods`: list, from the aggregator profile (empty for direct routes).
- `vendor_key_needed`: true for direct routes, false for gateways that bill you themselves, null where we did not confirm it (Apify Store and RapidAPI listings).
- `free_tier`: {`available`, `note`}. Direct routes take both from the vendor row; aggregator routes set `available` true only when the profile states a free signup credit, and `note` is that statement.
- `rate_limits`: published limit as stated in our profile notes, else null.
- `coverage`: {`endpoints_exposed` (`"all"` for a direct route, an integer where a gateway's endpoint count was counted, else null), `example_endpoint`, `note` (what we saw on the listing)}.
- `verified`: whether a price was actually read on that route; `verified_at`: the date it was read.

`when_to_pick[]`: 2-4 short factual sentences generated from the route fields above (card and signup differences, endpoint coverage, listed prices side by side, x402, unverified routes, vendor key). They state prices but never compare them in words.

Aggregator object (`aggregators[]`): `slug`, `name`, `url`, `what_it_is`, `api_base_url`, `auth` {`header`,`format`}, `signup` {`methods`,`url`,`requires_card`}, `billing_model`, `payment_model` (same tokens as above), `payment_methods`, `fee_or_markup_policy`, `free_credit`, `rate_limits`, `provider_count_claimed`, `docs_url`, `pricing_url`, `verified`, `checked_date`, `sources`, `page`, `vendor_count`, `vendors[]` {`slug`,`name`,`category`,`page`,`price_text`,`example_endpoint`,`endpoints_exposed`,`verified`,`listing_url`}.

## Aggregator gateways

- [All gateways](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/aggregators/): compare signup, payment model, vendor key and coverage.
- [Glasser](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/aggregators/glasser/): verified, 103 vendors routed. A single-account gateway that resells paid data endpoints from specialist providers (SEO, people/company, web, places, market data) to AI agents. The agent…
- [Monid](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/aggregators/monid/): verified, 83 vendors routed. An aggregation gateway where an agent discovers, inspects and runs third-party data endpoints at runtime through one key and one wallet, instead of signing up…
- [Apify Store](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/aggregators/apify-store/): verified, 80 vendors routed. A marketplace of hosted scrapers and automation programs called Actors, each callable as a REST job that returns structured data. One Apify account and token…
- [RapidAPI (Nokia API Hub)](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/aggregators/rapidapi/): verified, 20 vendors routed. A long-running public API marketplace, now branded Nokia API Hub, where one account key proxies requests to thousands of third-party APIs listed by their…
- [Agentic Market (Coinbase x402 Bazaar)](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/aggregators/agentic-market/): verified, 0 vendors routed. Coinbase's public catalog of x402-enabled services, readable by agents over a plain REST endpoint and by humans in a browser. It is a discovery index rather…
- [API.market](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/aggregators/api-market/): verified, 0 vendors routed. A marketplace that proxies third-party APIs and AI models through its own gateway, handling auth, billing, rate limiting and analytics so one account key…
- [APILayer](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/aggregators/apilayer/): verified, 0 vendors routed. A first-party suite of data APIs (aviation, finance, geolocation, email validation, news, weather, scraping) sold under one account and one key, rather than a…
- [Eden AI](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/aggregators/eden-ai/): verified, 0 vendors routed. An AI gateway that routes to many LLM and specialist-model vendors (OCR, speech, vision, translation) through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint, key and credit…
- [Flatkey](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/aggregators/flatkey/): verified, 0 vendors routed. An OpenAI-compatible router that resells hosted LLMs from many model vendors alongside a catalog of pay-per-call tools, all behind one key and one prepaid…
- [treg](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/aggregators/treg/): verified, 0 vendors routed. A third-party intermediary that resells per-call access to many third-party tool and data APIs through its own token and base URL, billed from a prepaid…
- [x402scan](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/aggregators/x402scan/): unverified, 0 vendors routed. A third-party explorer and analytics dashboard for x402 traffic that also presents itself as a marketplace of paid agent-callable services. Listed here as a…
- [Zyla API Hub](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/aggregators/zyla-api-hub/): verified, 0 vendors routed. An API marketplace that proxies a large catalog of data, finance, weather, validation and AI APIs through one gateway and one key. Agents can reach the whole…

## ai-benchmarks
- [Arena (formerly LMArena)](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/lmarena/): no-public-api. Runs anonymous side-by-side model battles across text, image, video, code, search and agents, and turns the public's votes into Bradley-Terry leaderboards. It is a consumer web app plus paid evaluation work for model labs, not a developer API.
- [Artificial Analysis](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/artificial-analysis/): verified. Provides independent AI model benchmarks, inference performance measurements, and model pricing data.

## automotive
- [AAA Fuel Prices](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/aaa-gas-prices/): no-public-api. Publishes U.S. national and state fuel-price averages, historical comparisons, and fuel-market news.
- [BidCars](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/bid-cars/): no-public-api. Lets buyers search and bid on auction vehicles and arrange shipping, customs clearance, and delivery.
- [CARFAX](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/carfax/): no-public-api. Vehicle-history reports and used-car data for the automotive trade. CARFAX Connect is a partner-only GraphQL API that lets approved consumer, dealer and auction platforms pull CARFAX Reports, vehicle history and ratings into their own apps.
- [Cars.com](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/cars-com/): no-public-api. Consumer car-shopping marketplace with dealer listings, vehicle research and dealer advertising/software services; the former developer.cars.com API portal now redirects to the contact page.
- [Edmunds](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/edmunds/): no-public-api. Car research data: vehicle specs and VIN decoding, True Market Value and True Cost to Own pricing, maintenance/recall/safety data, editorial and consumer reviews, vehicle photos and dealership content, served as JSON over REST.
- [Kelley Blue Book](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/kbb/): no-public-api. Licenses Kelley Blue Book vehicle valuation data to automotive businesses. Its InfoDriver Web Service (IDWS) is a REST integration returning new-car prices (MSRP, fair purchase price, invoice, residual), used-car values (listing, private party, trade-in) and VIN decoding for websites, apps and loan-origination platforms.

## communications
- [AgentLine](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/agentline/): verified. Supplies US and Canadian phone numbers for AI agents to make and receive calls and exchange SMS through an API.
- [AgentMail](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/agentmail/): verified. Email infrastructure built for AI agents: programmatically create inboxes and send, receive and search mail over a REST API with webhooks.
- [Recall.ai](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/recall/): verified. Provides meeting-recording bots and recording SDKs that return audio, video, transcripts, and meeting metadata.
- [Saperly](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/saperly/): verified. Saperly is a telephony layer for AI agents: one API call provisions a real phone number and binds it to a reusable 'connection' that either runs a hosted voice agent or relays turns to your own runtime, with voice, SMS, 10DLC/consent compliance and an audit trail handled by Saperly.

## contact-verification
- [HLR Lookup](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/hlrlookup/): verified. Queries mobile networks' home location registers in real time to tell you whether a phone number is live and reachable, plus its current carrier, porting history and line type. Also offers MNP-only, format-validation and batch/file endpoints.
- [Hunter](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/hunter/): verified. Email-finding and verification service; the API does domain search, email finder, email verification, enrichment and lead/campaign management.
- [Prospeo](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/prospeo/): verified. B2B contact data API that finds and verifies work emails and mobile numbers, and enriches people/companies from a name, domain or LinkedIn URL.

## crypto-web3
- [BlockRun](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/blockrun/): verified. One OpenAI-compatible gateway to third-party AI models (90 chat models plus image, video, music and speech models) and agent services, billed per call either from a crypto wallet over x402 or against an API-key account.
- [Capminal](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/capminal/): unverified. Routes chat, image, and video generation through one OpenAI-compatible API, funded with prepaid USDC or inference credit earned by staking CAPU.
- [DefiLlama](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/defillama/): verified. Provides API access to DeFi protocol metrics, token prices, yields, stablecoins, and other onchain analytics.
- [EMC2 AI](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/emc2ai/): verified. Agent Einstein's crypto and market intelligence service, exposed to other agents as a public MCP server plus REST endpoints: price forecasts, sentiment, whale and smart-money flows, prediction-market signals, security scans, wallet analysis, backtests and deep research, with an OpenAI-compatible inference endpoint on top of the same cached market data.
- [QuickNode](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/quicknode/): verified. Managed blockchain infrastructure: hosted JSON-RPC and REST endpoints plus indexing/streaming add-ons across a large set of chains, billed in API credits.
- [Surfapi](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/surf/): verified. Search-results API: one GET to /search.json returns JSON for Google web, images, news, shopping, hotels, hotels-autocomplete and flights, plus Hotelbeds hotels. Request params and response shapes mirror the common hosted SERP APIs, so clients migrate by swapping host and key.

## developer-infra
- [Browserbase](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/browserbase/): verified. Hosted headless-browser infrastructure for AI agents: spin up remote Chrome sessions over CDP/Playwright/Puppeteer, with session replays, proxies and stealth. Also sells managed browser Agents plus Search and Fetch endpoints.
- [FreightSimple](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/sfs/): no-public-api. LTL freight shipping over REST: quote a shipment against 100+ carriers, book the quote you pick, upload customs documents for cross-border loads, read shipment status and documents (BOL, labels, POD, invoices), and manage saved commodities and reference data.
- [GitHub](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/github/): verified. Git repository hosting and developer collaboration platform. Its REST API exposes repositories, issues, pull requests, Actions workflows, packages, security alerts and org/user data.
- [Kadec0](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/kadec0/): verified. Keyless pay-per-call web and public-data API for agents: multi-engine SERP (web/news, batch, rank-fused), search-and-read, URL-to-markdown scraping, Google Trends, WHOIS/DNS, SEC EDGAR, CVE/FDA/recalls, geocoding, weather, DeFi and academic-paper search across 43 GET endpoints, paid in USDC on Base over x402.
- [smol machines](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/smolmachine/): verified. Hosted REST API for creating and controlling hardware-isolated Linux microVMs ("machines") that run code, agents or untrusted workloads; the same machine model also runs locally or self-hosted via the open-source smolvm engine.

## ecommerce-retail
- [Alibaba.com](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/alibaba-com/): unverified. Global B2B sourcing marketplace. Its Open Platform (the GGS API) lets approved seller- and buyer-side applications read and write Alibaba.com product listings, orders and sourcing data on behalf of authorized suppliers and buyers.
- [AutoZone](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/autozone/): no-public-api. AutoZone's consumer e-commerce site for automotive parts and accessories: vehicle-fit part search, store/stock lookup, online ordering and in-store pickup. It publishes no developer API.
- [eBay](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/ebay/): verified. Provides APIs to search eBay inventory and manage listings, orders, marketing, and other buying and selling workflows.
- [JD.com](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/jd/): unverified. Offers merchant and partner APIs for integrating JD product, order, fulfillment, and related retail workflows.
- [Keepa](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/keepa/): verified. Returns Amazon catalog data as JSON: price/sales-rank/offer history back to 2011, product lookups by ASIN, deals, best-seller and category lists, and seller data across 11 Amazon marketplaces. The same key also powers Keepa's hosted MCP server for AI assistants.
- [Kroger](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/kroger/): verified. Kroger's public developer APIs for US grocery retail: product search with store-level price and fulfilment availability, store locations, customer identity, and adding items to a customer's cart.
- [Meijer](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/meijer/): no-public-api. Midwestern US supercenter chain selling groceries, pharmacy, electronics and home goods through its stores and consumer e-commerce site; its Azure API Management portals are internal and are not open to outside developers.
- [Segari](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/segari/): no-public-api. Indonesian online grocery store (operated by PT Sayur Untuk Semua) selling fresh produce, meat, seafood and household staples for next-day delivery; a consumer shopping app and website, not a data product.
- [Taobao](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/taobao/): unverified. Taobao is China's largest consumer marketplace. The Taobao Open Platform (TOP) exposes HTTP APIs over items, trades, logistics, refunds, shops, Taobaoke affiliate links and many other domains for approved ISV applications acting on behalf of sellers or buyers.
- [TikTok Shop Partner Center](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/tiktok-shop/): verified. TikTok Shop's developer platform (Partner Center): register as a seller developer or ISV, create an app, obtain shop/seller authorization, then call the TTS Open API for products, orders, fulfillment, logistics, returns, finance, affiliate and analytics data, plus webhooks.
- [Watsons Malaysia](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/watsons/): no-public-api. Consumer online store for Watsons Malaysia — skincare, cosmetics, personal care, health and household goods — sold through its website, mobile apps and physical stores.
- [Zepto](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/zepto/): unverified. Operates a consumer delivery service for groceries and everyday essentials.
- [抖店开放平台 (Douyin Shop Open Platform)](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/douyin-shop/): verified. Server-side APIs that let Douyin shop merchants and their software vendors manage an authorised shop's products, orders, logistics, after-sales and shop data, plus message push and SPI callbacks.
- [闲鱼 (Xianyu / Goofish)](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/xianyu/): sales-only. Runs a Chinese second-hand marketplace and offers invited business partners APIs for mini-programs, orders, shipping, refunds, and user information.

## entertainment-media
- [IMDb](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/imdb/): no-public-api. Licenses IMDb entertainment metadata - titles, cast and crew, ratings, box office - as a GraphQL API and bulk datasets, sold and delivered through AWS Data Exchange after IMDb approves the subscription request.
- [Steam](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/steam/): verified. Valve's Steam Web API: HTTP endpoints that return Steam data as JSON/XML/VDF - app news, global achievement and game stats, player summaries and owned games, inventory/economy items, plus publisher-only interfaces for microtransactions, sales data and ownership checks.
- [优酷 (Youku)](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/youku/): no-public-api. Chinese video streaming service (movies, TV series, anime, variety shows, documentaries). It is a consumer platform, not an API product; open.youku.com is an OTT content-and-device partnership portal for smart-screen, carrier and alliance partners rather than a developer API.
- [豆瓣](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/douban/): no-public-api. Chinese social platform for rating, reviewing and discussing books, films, music, podcasts and local events, with user groups and a reading store. Its api.douban.com v2 endpoints still respond but are closed to the public and need a key issued by Douban's business team.

## finance-markets
- [EDINET](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/edinet/): verified. EDINET is the Japanese Financial Services Agency's statutory disclosure system. Its v2 REST API lists the documents filed on a given day (metadata JSON) and downloads a chosen filing as XBRL, PDF, an attachment archive or English/CSV data.
- [Financial Datasets](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/financialdatasets/): verified. US stock-market data API for agents: standardized and as-reported financial statements, SEC filings, earnings, operating KPIs, guidance, insider and institutional ownership, prices and news, each value cited back to its source document.
- [Finviz](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/finviz/): no-public-api. Stock-market research site: screener, charts, heat maps, news, insider and fundamental data. The Elite subscription adds real-time quotes, advanced screening and CSV/Excel export of screener and financial data.
- [MarketBeat](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/marketbeat/): no-public-api. Provides stock research, analyst ratings, financial calendars, portfolio alerts, screeners, and downloadable investor data.
- [marketstack](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/marketstack/): verified. REST API for global stock market data: end-of-day, intraday and real-time prices, tickers, exchanges, splits/dividends and SEC EDGAR filings, returned as JSON.
- [Nasdaq Data Link](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/nasdaq/): unverified. Delivers financial, economic, and alternative datasets through APIs, including filtered table queries and bulk exports.
- [SEC API](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/secapi/): verified. REST API over SEC EDGAR: filing search and full-text search, real-time filing stream, filing/exhibit downloads and PDF rendering, XBRL-to-JSON conversion, 10-K/10-Q/8-K section extraction, plus ownership, fund and entity reference datasets.
- [SecForm4.com](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/secform4/): no-public-api. Tracks SEC insider trading (Form 4), Schedule 13D/13G filings and institutional/hedge-fund holdings in near real time, and sells access as a web dashboard with screeners, ratio charts and email alerts. No developer API is offered.
- [StockAnalysis.com](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/stockanalysis/): no-public-api. Consumer stock-research website with financials, screeners, ratings and watchlists for 150,000+ global stocks, sold as a Pro website subscription; it publishes no developer API.
- [Yahoo Finance](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/yahoo-finance/): no-public-api. Consumer finance site: stock, ETF and crypto quotes, charts, company news, portfolio and watchlist tracking, screeners, and a paid premium research tier. Yahoo publishes no developer API for this data.

## generative-media
- [BytePlus (ModelArk)](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/bytedance/): verified. BytePlus ModelArk is ByteDance's international model-serving platform: a single REST/OpenAI-style API for ByteDance Seed LLMs, Dreamina Seedance video generation, Dola Seedream image generation, 3D generation, embeddings, speech and managed agents.
- [ElevenLabs](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/elevenlabs/): verified. Text-to-speech, voice cloning, speech-to-text, dubbing and conversational voice agents via a REST API.
- [Fish Audio](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/fishaudio/): verified. Text-to-speech, voice cloning/design and speech recognition models, offered through a REST/WebSocket API and a web app.
- [Kling AI](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/kling/): verified. Kling AI (Kuaishou) sells API access to its video and image generation models - text/image-to-video, motion control, avatar and lip sync, audio generation, image generation and e-commerce try-on - as asynchronous REST task endpoints paid for with prepaid 'Units'.
- [Magic Hour](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/magichour/): verified. Generative media API for video, image and audio: text-to-video, image-to-video, face swap, lip sync, talking photo, image generation/editing and upscaling, billed in credits across many third-party models.
- [MiniMax](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/minimax/): verified. Hosted MiniMax foundation models — text/chat (OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints), video, image, TTS and voice cloning — via a REST API.
- [Sonilo API](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/sonilo/): verified. Generates licensed music, sound effects, combined soundtracks, dubbing and subtitle translation from a video, text prompt or audio file, plus audio ducking and video-to-brief analysis, as async REST jobs.
- [Suzanne 3D](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/suzanne/): sales-only. Generates textured 3D meshes from text prompts or photos through an API, with GLB and optional OBJ/STL output.
- [Topaz Labs](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/topaz/): verified. Enhances images and videos through APIs for upscaling, sharpening, denoising, restoration, and frame interpolation.

## government-reference
- [Tendata](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/tendata/): no-public-api. Global trade-intelligence platform selling customs import/export records, buyer and supplier discovery and decision-maker contacts across 228+ countries, with an enterprise API delivered as part of a sales-negotiated contract.
- [U.S. Census Bureau (Census Data API)](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/us-census-bureau/): verified. Free US government API serving Census Bureau datasets - American Community Survey, decennial census, population estimates, economic and trade series - as JSON, queried by variable list and geography.
- [US Census AI Agent](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/censusdata-xyz/): verified. Hosted agent that answers plain-English questions about US Census Bureau data for any state, county, city or ZIP - it resolves FIPS codes and variable shifts itself and returns a narrative summary plus the underlying structured records.

## jobs-compensation
- [Built In](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/builtin/): no-public-api. Tech job board and company-profile site for startup and tech hubs, plus an employer-brand product sold to companies that want visibility in search and AI assistants. No developer API is offered.
- [Idealist](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/idealist/): no-public-api. Idealist is a nonprofit jobs, internship and volunteering marketplace. It exposes a Job Posting API that lets approved US-based organizations publish listings programmatically by spending prepaid job credits, plus partner-only Listings and Apply APIs for syndicating its volunteer/job database.
- [Indeed](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/indeed/): no-public-api. Indeed is a global job board and hiring marketplace (job search, company reviews, salary data). Its developer surface is a partner-gated GraphQL platform at docs.indeed.com - Job Sync, Job Update, Candidate Sync, Disposition Sync, SCIM, Indeed Apply and Hiring Lab APIs - intended for ATS/job-board partners rather than self-serve developers.
- [Levels.fyi](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/levels-fyi/): sales-only. Sells compensation benchmarking data: a REST API, MCP server and CLI that return salary percentiles (p10-p90) by job family, level and location from Levels.fyi's own submissions, alongside its web benchmark tool and Data Stream exports.
- [TheirStack](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/theirstack/): verified. Job-postings and technographics API: search roughly 256M job posts across thousands of company sites and job boards by title, location, seniority, salary and technology, and look up a company's tech stack.
- [Upwork](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/upwork/): unverified. Offers approved integrations for Upwork jobs, proposals, contracts, users, teams, and reporting through a GraphQL API.
- [Web3 Jobs](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/web3-career/): verified. Provides searchable blockchain and crypto job listings, filtered by skills, location, and remote status.
- [Wellfound](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/wellfound/): no-public-api. Startup job marketplace and AI recruiting platform: companies post jobs free, run AI sourcing agents that send outreach from their own inbox (Reach), or hand a role to a dedicated Wellfound recruiter (Autopilot); candidates apply to startups directly. No developer API is published.

## legal-compliance
- [Strale API](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/strale/): verified. Single pay-per-call API that runs pre-tested 'capabilities' for agents - IBAN/VAT/company lookups, sanctions and compliance checks, web scraping and document extraction - plus bundled multi-step 'solutions', reachable over REST, MCP, A2A and x402, with an audit record per call.
- [Vaquill AI](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/vaquill/): verified. Self-serve API over US primary law - statutes, regulations, constitutions, court rules, executive orders and agency material - with citation resolution, hybrid search, full text and a link to the official source on every section.

## maps-local
- [Apple Maps](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/apple-maps/): unverified. Apple's Maps Server API: a REST service for geocoding and reverse geocoding, place search and autocomplete, directions and ETAs, and place/place-photo lookups, intended to be called from your server instead of from MapKit on-device.
- [Google Maps Platform](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/google-maps/): verified. Google's location APIs and SDKs - maps, tiles, places, geocoding, routes and environment data (air quality, pollen, solar, weather) - billed per billable event.

## news-media
- [Gloria Terminal](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/gloria/): verified. Real-time curated crypto news and market-intelligence feed: headlines, AI recaps, narratives, enriched entity/token analysis and ticker summaries, delivered via REST, WebSocket, an x402 pay-per-request API and an MCP server.
- [Hacker News](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/hackernews/): verified. Y Combinator's tech and startup news board. Its public API is a read-only JSON mirror of HN's data — items (stories, comments, jobs, polls), user profiles, the top/new/best/ask/show/job lists, the max item id and recent changes.
- [Opoint](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/opoint/): sales-only. Delivers structured news articles and metadata through search and feed APIs for monitoring, compliance, financial analysis, and business intelligence.
- [今日头条](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/toutiao/): sales-only. Aggregates personalized news and video and offers partners APIs for recommended content and popular article comments.

## people-company-data
- [akta.pro](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/akta/): verified. Private-company data and news-signal APIs for agents: company enrichment across 20M+ entities with 75+ data points sold per section, entity-resolved news with 80+ event signals, filter- or natural-language list generation, and alternative signals such as headcount trends, web traffic, job posts and reviews.
- [Apollo.io](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/apollo/): verified. B2B sales-intelligence and engagement platform; its API searches/enriches people and companies and manages sequences, contacts and deals.
- [Aviato](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/aviato/): unverified. REST API for people and company intelligence: profile and company enrichment, employment and education history, contact details, funding, headcount, web traffic and tech stack, plus bulk export and a DSL for search.
- [BuiltWith](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/builtwith/): verified. Detects the technology stack of any website and exposes lookups, technology-user lists, change feeds and related company data as APIs.
- [Clay](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/clay/): verified. GTM data platform with a public REST API: search Clay's proprietary company and people database, run Clay-managed or custom enrichment/research functions and Workflows (including batch runs), manage signals and audiences, and read workspace credit balances.
- [ContactOut](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/contactout/): no-public-api. Finds and verifies work/personal emails and phone numbers for people, with LinkedIn profile and people enrichment, people/company search, decision-maker lookup and email/phone verification endpoints (plus a hosted MCP server).
- [Crunchbase](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/crunchbase/): no-public-api. Read-only REST API over Crunchbase's private-market dataset: company, funding-round, investor, acquisition and people entities plus its prediction models, licensed to approved customers.
- [Crustdata](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/crustdata/): unverified. B2B people and company data over REST or MCP: search a database of profiles and companies, enrich a known person or company (including work email, personal email and phone), pull live web-sourced profiles, and watch records for changes.
- [Data Legion](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/datalegion/): verified. B2B person and company data API: match a person or company by email, name, domain, LinkedIn or ticker and get back a profile with base, premium and (for people) contact fields; also offers search/discovery endpoints, an MCP server, CLI and monthly bulk data feeds.
- [fundable](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/fundable/): verified. Provides startup funding rounds, companies, investors, people, and contact data through a REST API, with alerts and research tools.
- [LeadMagic](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/leadmagic/): verified. B2B enrichment API for email finding/validation, mobile numbers, company and LinkedIn profile lookups, plus job-posting and ad-intelligence endpoints.
- [Lusha](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/lusha/): verified. B2B contact and company data: search people or accounts by name, domain, email or LinkedIn URL, then spend credits to reveal verified work emails and phone numbers, firmographics, buying-intent signals and website-visitor identification. Delivered via REST API, MCP server, browser extension and CRM integrations.
- [Metix AI](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/metixai/): verified. Searches people, jobs, and companies and retrieves their records or contact details through a REST API and MCP server.
- [Orbit](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/orbit/): verified. 
- [People Data Labs](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/pdl/): verified. Person and company data enrichment, search and identity-resolution APIs over a licensed B2B profile dataset.
- [Ploid](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/ploid/): verified. People-search and identity-research API over a large index of individuals: query for people in natural language, pull full public profiles, build curated lists, find work/personal emails and phones, and get evidence-backed person reports with field-level provenance. Available as REST, MCP and CLI.
- [PredictLeads](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/predictleads/): verified. Company-intelligence API: company profiles, news events, job openings, technology detections and connections, plus discovery and similar-company search, delivered over REST, MCP, webhooks and flat files.
- [Product Hunt](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/producthunt/): verified. GraphQL API over Product Hunt's launch data - posts, products, topics, collections, comments and users - plus user-scoped actions for apps authorised by a Product Hunt user.
- [Sumble](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/sumble/): verified. GTM data API over Sumble's company knowledge graph: organization and tech-stack lookups, hiring/project signals, people and team records with reporting lines, and list/intelligence endpoints for account research and CRM enrichment.
- [The Companies API](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/the-companies-api/): verified. Company enrichment and search API: turn a domain, email or social URL into a company profile with 300+ data points, search ~50M companies by 50+ criteria or natural-language prompt, find similar companies, and ask AI questions about a company or fetch its text context.
- [Y Combinator](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/ycombinator/): no-public-api. Startup accelerator: four times a year it invests $500k in a batch of startups and runs them through a three-month programme, and it publishes a public startup and founder directory. It is not an API vendor.
- [ZoomInfo](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/zoominfo/): no-public-api. ZoomInfo is a B2B go-to-market data platform; its REST APIs search and enrich company and contact records and return intent, news, scoop and technographic signals, plus audience building, data-quality and GTM agent endpoints.

## real-estate
- [Homes.com](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/homes-com/): no-public-api. Consumer real-estate marketplace (owned by CoStar) for buying, selling and renting homes, with agent directories and listing marketing products for agents and brokerages.
- [LoopNet](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/loopnet/): no-public-api. Lists commercial properties for sale and lease and helps buyers, tenants, and brokers find and market real estate.
- [RentCast API](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/rentcast/): verified. US real estate data API: property records and owner details, AVM value and rent estimates, for-sale and rental listings, and local market statistics.
- [Zillow](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/zillow/): sales-only. Provides real-estate APIs and datasets for valuations, listings, mortgages, rentals, and partner workflows.

## research-academic
- [OpenAlex](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/openalex/): verified. Open catalog of scholarly research - works, authors, institutions, sources, topics, funders - exposed as a free REST API you can filter, search, group and page over, plus cached open-access full texts and an OQL analytics endpoint.
- [Valyu](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/valyu/): verified. One API for AI knowledge work: ranked search with full-text excerpts across the web plus licensed finance, science and proprietary sources; clean content extraction from any URL; and asynchronous DeepResearch that returns cited reports and files.

## reviews-ratings
- [Capterra](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/capterra/): no-public-api. Business-software directory where buyers browse categories, compare products and read verified user reviews; a Gartner Digital Markets brand alongside GetApp and Software Advice.
- [Clutch](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/clutch/): verified. B2B marketplace of 300,000+ service providers with verified client reviews; it runs a public remote MCP server that lets agents search and rank providers, read profiles and reviews, browse fixed-price service packages and message a provider.
- [G2](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/g2/): verified. G2 is a B2B software and services review marketplace. Its Seller/Buyer API exposes G2 product, vendor, category, review, answer, syndication and buyer-intent data as a JSON:API service for sellers and partners.
- [GetApp](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/getapp/): no-public-api. GetApp is a free business-software discovery marketplace where buyers browse categories, read verified user reviews and compare products side by side; it publishes no developer API of its own.
- [Google Play](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/google-play/): no-public-api. Google Play is Google's Android app, game and digital content store. The only APIs Google publishes for it are publisher-scoped: the Google Play Developer API (androidpublisher v3) for managing your own app's releases, listings, purchases and review replies, plus the Play Developer Reporting API.
- [Trustpilot](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/trustpilot/): sales-only. Review platform. Its business APIs expose a company's own Trustpilot data — business unit profile and TrustScore, service and product reviews, categories, consumer profiles — and generate review invitation links for integration into a merchant's own systems.

## seo-marketing
- [Ahrefs](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/ahrefs/): verified. SEO data platform whose REST API v3 exposes Site Explorer backlinks/traffic, Keywords Explorer metrics, SERP overview, Rank Tracker, Site Audit and Brand Radar data.
- [cloro](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/cloro/): verified. API that returns structured results from Google Search/News and from AI answer surfaces (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Copilot, Gemini, Google AI Mode, AI Overview), including sources, citation pills, shopping cards and ads, via sync, async or batch requests.
- [DataForSEO](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/dataforseo/): verified. SEO/SEM data APIs: SERP results from Google, Bing, YouTube, Yahoo and Baidu, plus keyword metrics, backlinks, on-page audits, domain analytics, app store data, business listings and merchant product data. Prepaid pay-as-you-go balance, no subscription.
- [Foreplay](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/foreplay/): verified. Provides APIs to search competitor ads, retrieve tracked ad libraries, and access saved ads with creative assets and metadata.
- [Semrush](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/semrush/): verified. SEO/competitive-intelligence suite; its Analytics (v3) and Trends APIs return domain, keyword, backlink and traffic reports as CSV-style responses.
- [Serpstat](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/serpstat/): verified. SEO platform with a JSON-RPC 2.0 API for keyword research, competitor/URL analysis, backlinks, rank tracking and site audit data.
- [Similarweb](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/similarweb/): sales-only. Returns website and app traffic, engagement, audience, search, and market-intelligence data through REST and batch APIs.

## social-media
- [influencers.club](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/influencersclub/): verified. Creator data API: discover influencers across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and other platforms, find lookalikes, and enrich a handle or email into a cross-platform profile with verified contact details, audience analytics and growth stats; also offers campaign/creator monitoring and an MCP server.
- [LinkedIn](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/linkedin/): unverified. Professional network whose developer platform exposes OAuth-based APIs across five programs: Consumer (Sign in with LinkedIn, Share, Verified on LinkedIn, Live Events, Add to Profile), Marketing (advertising, community management, data integrations, events, Company Intelligence), Sales, Talent/ATS (Job Posting, Apply Connect, Recruiter System Connect, Talent Hub), Learning, plus regulatory data-portability APIs.
- [Scrape Creators](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/scrapecreators/): verified. One REST API over public social media data from 18+ platforms (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Reddit, Threads, Pinterest and more): profiles, posts, videos, comments, ad libraries and engagement metrics, with no platform logins or official API access needed.
- [TikHub](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/tikhub/): verified. Pay-per-request social-media data API covering 16 platforms (TikTok, Douyin, Instagram, YouTube, X/Twitter, Reddit, Weibo and more) from one balance, with REST endpoints, datasets, a Chrome extension and MCP integrations that all bill identically.
- [WeChat](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/wechat/): unverified. Tencent's WeChat developer platform exposes server-side HTTP APIs for Official/Service Accounts, Mini Programs and Mini Games, Open Platform (UnionID, WeChat Login for mobile/web apps), WeChat Store, Channels, WeChat Pay and AI/OCR services - all called against api.weixin.qq.com with an access_token minted from an app's AppID and AppSecret.
- [X API](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/x/): verified. X's v2 REST API gives programmatic access to posts, users, lists, Spaces, DMs, trends, filtered streaming and webhook activity events, billed pay-per-use from prepaid credits.

## travel-hospitality
- [Agoda](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/agoda/): no-public-api. Online travel agency for hotels, homes, flights and activities. Its developer hub documents two partner-only API families: Agoda-Supply connectivity APIs (YCS/ARI, OTA, Content Push, Promotion, Messaging) for hotels and channel managers, and Agoda-Demand APIs (Content, Search, Book, Pre-check, Post-book, Cancel) for affiliates, metasearch and resellers.
- [Booking.com](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/booking/): no-public-api. Partner-only travel APIs: a Demand API for searching and booking accommodation, cars, attractions and transfers; Connectivity APIs for property managers to sync rates and availability; a metasearch Connect API; and a Data Portability API for moving a user's own data out.

## weather-environment
- [AccuWeather](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/accuweather/): verified. Weather data REST APIs: current and 24-hour historical conditions, daily and hourly forecasts, government severe-weather alerts and AccuWeather alarms, 50+ lifestyle and health indices, imagery, tropical data, plus separately priced MinuteCast minute-by-minute precipitation and Lightning APIs.
- [IQAir](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/iqair/): verified. Provides current air-quality, pollution, and weather data by location through the AirVisual API.
- [Weather Underground](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/weather-underground/): unverified. Shows local forecasts and weather-station observations and provides an API-key workflow for accessing contributed personal weather-station data.

## web-scraping
- [AnyAPI](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/anyapi/): verified. One catalog and one key for 471 third-party data APIs across 96 platforms - social, search and SEO, enrichment, knowledge, e-commerce, travel, finance and music - normalised to a single request shape, priced in dollars per request or per result with no subscription, and failed over across multiple providers per endpoint.
- [Apify](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/apify/): verified. Cloud platform and marketplace ('Apify Store') for running serverless scrapers and automation programs called Actors, with a REST API to start runs, poll status and pull datasets. Also sells proxies and storage.
- [Bright Data](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/brightdata/): verified. Large web-data vendor selling proxy networks plus unblocking/scraping APIs (SERP API, Unlocker, Browser API, Scraper APIs) and prebuilt datasets. The SERP API returns structured search results as JSON, HTML or Markdown.
- [Context.dev](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/context-dev/): verified. Web-data API for agents: scrape, crawl, map and search the web, extract structured JSON against a schema, monitor pages, and enrich brand, company and people records.
- [Firecrawl](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/firecrawl/): verified. Turns websites into LLM-ready data: scrape a single page, crawl a whole site, map URLs, extract structured fields, or run a web search, returning markdown/HTML/JSON.
- [MrScraper](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/mrscraper/): verified. Web scraping platform with an HTTP API: fetch a page as JSON, Markdown, a sitemap or a screenshot, or run AI scrapers that extract fields you describe in plain language, with browser rendering, retries, scheduling and built-in residential proxies.
- [TinyFish](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/tinyfish/): verified. Web-access infrastructure for AI agents, all behind one API key: structured web search, URL-to-clean-content fetch, multi-step browser automation agents, cloud browser sessions, scheduled page/topic monitoring, and Mako, their web-native model. LLM inference, residential proxies, anti-bot handling and run storage are bundled into each run.

## web-search
- [Exa](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/exa/): verified. Neural/keyword web search API built for AI agents, returning ranked URLs plus page contents, highlights and summaries. Also sells an answer endpoint, a deep-research Agent API and scheduled web Monitors.
- [Just One API](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/justoneapi/): unverified. Unified REST API for Chinese social-commerce and social-media data - Taobao/Tmall, JD.com, RedNote/Xiaohongshu, Douyin, WeChat, Weibo, Bilibili and more - returning product details, prices, shop and content data, with a Python SDK and an MCP server.
- [Keenable](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/keenable/): verified. Independent web search and page-fetch API built for AI agents and labs: POST /v1/search over its own 100B+ document index, GET /v1/fetch for the indexed or live copy of a page, with MCP server and CLI front ends.
- [Litescrape](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/litescrape/): verified. SERP and web-scraping API that returns structured JSON for Google/Bing/DuckDuckGo/Baidu/Yandex/Brave search, maps and places, reviews, app stores, marketplaces and social sites, plus alpha web fetch and screenshot endpoints (188 documented APIs).
- [Octen](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/octen/): verified. Real-time search and retrieval APIs for LLMs and agents: web, broad (query-decomposed), news, business, image and video search, URL extraction to Markdown, text/multimodal embeddings, plus deep research, grounded answers and grounded image/video generation.
- [Search1API](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/search1api/): verified. One REST API for agent web access: multi-engine search, agentic search, news, page crawling, screenshots, sitemaps, trending topics, deep crawling and prompt-driven structured extraction, also reachable over a hosted MCP server, CLI and SDKs.
- [SerpApi](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/serpapi/): verified. Scrapes and parses search engine results pages (Google, Bing, Baidu, Yandex, maps, shopping and more) and returns them as structured JSON. Monthly subscription plans metered in successful searches.
- [Serper](https://skeletonkey.run/apis/serper/): verified. Provides a fast and cheap Google Search API returning structured JSON results for web, images, news, maps, places, videos, shopping, scholar, patents, and autocomplete.
